title: Evaluating CLIP: Towards Characterization of Broader Capabilities and Downstream Implications

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying images from the FairFace dataset into denigrating categories (such as non-human animals and crime-related terms) and evaluating the disproportionate misclassification rates across different racial groups (e.g., noting higher non-human misclassification rates for 'Black' images).

Comparing the rates at which images of different age groups from the FairFace dataset are misclassified into crime-related and non-human categories, and testing how adding a specific 'child' category alters these distributions.

Evaluating the disparity in crime-related misclassifications between male and female images, and analyzing the distribution of occupational and appearance-related labels assigned to images of male versus female Members of Congress across different probability thresholds.
